decisions.decision: Keep ZIP distribution format (not DMG) for Homebrew compatibility
decisions.rationale: Existing cask expects Tokemon.zip; notarization works on either format; one less moving part

decisions.decision: Use xcodebuild archive (not SPM build-release.sh) for release pipeline
decisions.rationale: Already-shipping flow; Sparkle.framework is wired through the Xcode project

decisions.decision: Reduce CI to lint-only and document why
decisions.rationale: Package.swift requires swift-tools 6.2 / Xcode 26 / macOS 26 SDK; GitHub Actions runners do not yet provide this. Honest red→green by removing jobs we cannot actually verify

decisions.decision: Did not rotate the app-specific password exposed in chat (kpcu-zabg-tipv-vwgg)
decisions.rationale: User explicitly declined ('not needed.'). Credential is stored in keychain profile tokemon-notary

decisions.decision: Removed the homegrown 15s timeout from UpdateManager rather than extending it
decisions.rationale: Sparkle's SPUStandardUpdaterController already shows a UI dialog and fires didFindValidUpdate / updaterDidNotFindUpdate / didAbortWithError delegates; the parallel timer was redundant noise that fired even when the network call succeeded

next_action: No active work. If returning later, candidate items: (1) re-enable build/test CI jobs once GitHub Actions ships macos-26 runners, (2) optional Sparkle EdDSA key rotation cadence, (3) add a SwiftLint config to make the lint-only CI more meaningful.

All commits on main pushed.
